name: West London Technology Park
notes: Greystoke describes a 90MW project next to the M25 in Buckinghamshire with outline/reserved matters activity; January 2026 reporting says the UK government admitted an error in approval and permission was likely to be quashed, so current planning status is uncertain.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Pinewood South Data Centre
notes: Pinewood submitted a Buckinghamshire Council application for a 55,030 sqm data centre on Pinewood South; Pinewood later said the council resolved to grant planning permission. Capacity/end-user not disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Denham Data Centre
notes: Outline proposal for a hyperscale data centre on land north of the M40 and both sides of Denham Court Drive; reporting describes two buildings totaling about 60,000 sqm on Green Belt land, with local objections.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Redcentric Elland Data Centre
notes: Operational Tier-3-aligned facility at Lowfields Business Park, Elland, within Calderdale; public datasheet gives location and facility details but not MW capacity.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Lloyds Copley Data Centre
notes: Lloyds-owned office and data centre campus on Wakefield Road/Copley near Halifax was reported for sale, with Lloyds expected to exit in 2025; current operating/future status should be rechecked before use.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Exaflops Halifax
notes: Public directory listing for Exaflops at Calderdale Business Park, Halifax, offering IaaS/HPC/AI/ML/GPU services; capacity not disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Cambridge Innovation Campus / CAMRO Data Park
notes: AiOnX/SWI announced a Sutton-in-the-Isle data centre campus between Cambridge and Peterborough, scaled to 330MW. Earlier CAMRO/Savills material for the same Elean/Sutton area reports full planning approval for 700,000 sq ft and ability to deliver 180MVA.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Houghton Regis / Linmere Island Data Centre
notes: Two-building data centre proposal at the Linmere Island site in Houghton Regis North; DCD and Foxglove report Amazon/AWS links via Colliers/Amazon Data Services references, but IT capacity is not disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Quest Park Data Centre Campus
notes: QuestPit proposes a 143-acre campus at Ampthill Road, Stewartby, Central Bedfordshire. Government issued a Section 35 direction for the project; DCD reports four buildings and 720MW eventual IT capacity, while the project site states around 1GW long-term capability.
